audience: event organizers who sell tickets and run check-in with Humanitix

useCases.title: Check our events, ticket types and capacity
useCases.text: Lists events, upcoming ones or those changed since a date, with dates, ticket types, pricing and capacity, and reads one event in detail.

useCases.title: Count how many attendees have checked in
useCases.text: Gets the check-in count for one date of an event, in total and per ticket type.

useCases.title: List the orders of an event with buyers
useCases.text: Lists an event's orders with buyer name and email, financial status, totals, discounts and payment type, and reads one order with its checkout answers.

useCases.title: Show attendees with ticket type and check-in status
useCases.text: Lists an event's tickets, complete or cancelled only, with attendee name, ticket type, price and check-in state, and reads one ticket's check-in history.

useCases.title: Check a ticket in or out at the door
useCases.text: Marks a ticket as checked in, or checks it out again to undo a mistake or track re-entry.

useCases.title: Create an event or change its details
useCases.text: Creates a base event with name, dates, timezone and location, or changes the details of an event and adds or reschedules its dates.
